record.paper_title: Open problems in local discrete holomorphic dynamics
record.original_question: Let λ⃗=(λ_1,...,λ_n) be eigenvalues for a diagonalizable differential, and suppose the Brjuno-type series Σ_{k≥0} 2^{-k} log(1/Ω_{λ⃗}(2^{k+1})) diverges. Does there then exist a formally linearizable germ f in End(C^n, O) with those eigenvalues that fails to be holomorphically linearizable?

evidence.quote: (OP17) Let ~λ = (λ1, . . . , λn) ∈ C^n be such that Σ ... = +∞. Is it possible to find f ∈ End(C^n, O), with diagonalizable differential having eigenvalues λ1, . . . , λn, which is formally linearizable but not holomorphically linearizable?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setting. For an n-tuple λ⃗ = (λ_1, …, λ_n) ∈ (ℂ*)^n and an integer m ≥ 2, define
   Ω_{λ⃗}(m) = min { |λ^Q − λ_j| : 1 ≤ j ≤ n, Q ∈ ℕ^n, 2 ≤ |Q| ≤ m, λ^Q ≠ λ_j },
where λ^Q := λ_1^{q_1} ⋯ λ_n^{q_n} and |Q| = q_1 + ⋯ + q_n. The (multidimensional) Brjuno-type series associated with λ⃗ is
   B(λ⃗) := Σ_{k ≥ 0} 2^{−k} log( 1 / Ω_{λ⃗}(2^{k+1}) ).
A germ f ∈ End(ℂ^n, O) of holomorphic self-map fixing the origin with df_O diagonalizable and eigenvalues λ⃗ is said to be formally linearizable if there is a formal power-series change of coordinates conjugating f to its linear part diag(λ_1, …, λ_n); it is holomorphically linearizable if such a conjugation can be chosen to converge in some neighborhood of O.

Question. Suppose λ⃗ ∈ (ℂ*)^n satisfies B(λ⃗) = +∞. Does there necessarily exist a germ f ∈ End(ℂ^n, O) with diagonalizable differential at O having eigenvalues λ_1, …, λ_n such that f is formally linearizable but not holomorphically linearizable?
artifact.status_search_result: The necessity of the multidimensional Brjuno condition for holomorphic linearization of germs in End(ℂ^n, O) with diagonalizable differential is a classical open problem in local discrete holomorphic dynamics. Yoccoz established necessity in dimension one; the higher-dimensional analogue remains unresolved, with recent work (e.g., on quasi-periodic flows, semi-standard maps, and Gevrey settings) exploring related sufficient conditions but not settling necessity for germs in several complex variables.

status_evidence.title: Linearization of Gevrey flows on Td with a Brjuno type arithmetical condition
status_evidence.snippet: In the Gevrey topology, a d-torus flow close enough to linear with a unique rotation vector ω is linearizable as long as ω satisfies a novel Brjuno type diophantine condition.
status_evidence.claim: Multidimensional Brjuno-type conditions are studied as sufficient conditions in related linearization problems; necessity is not established.

status_evidence.title: Analytic linearization of a generalization of the semi-standard map: radius of convergence and Brjuno sum
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work investigates the relationship between Brjuno sums and analytic linearization in higher-dimensional and parametric settings.
status_evidence.claim: The relationship between divergence of Brjuno-type sums and failure of holomorphic linearizability remains an active topic.
